title: Inside Blackstone’s Massive Bet on the AI Boom
text: Blackstone has built one of Wall Street’s broadest bets on AI, investing across the ecosystem from data centers, power and cooling to chip financing and companies including OpenAI, Anthropic and SpaceX. Bloomberg’s Preeti Singh explains how President and COO Jon Gray spotted the infrastructure opportunity early and why he sees AI as a generational economic shift that investors can’t afford to ignore. She joins Ed Ludlow on "Bloomberg Tech." (Source: Bloomberg)
